categories.main_business_segments: Beijing Haitian Ruisheng Science Technology Ltd. primarily engages in AI training data research, design, production, and sales. Its core business covers intelligent speech, computer vision, and natural language processing, serving applications such as human-computer interaction, intelligent driving, smart home, smart finance, and more. The company also provides customized training data services, standardized data products, and related application services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced AI algorithms including speech recognition (ASR), speech synthesis (TTS), computer vision, and natural language processing. It employs a comprehensive data production process involving dataset design, raw data collection, data annotation, and quality inspection. The firm has developed an integrated data processing platform with automation and algorithmic support to enhance efficiency and data quality. It also invests in multi-modal data, multi-language phonetic dictionaries, and Chain of Thought (CoT) datasets to support large model training and reasoning capabilities.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major domestic and international technology giants such as Alibaba, Tencent, Baidu, Microsoft, Amazon, Samsung, and research institutions like the Chinese Academy of Sciences and Tsinghua University. The company serves industries including technology internet, social media, IoT, intelligent driving, large AI models, government, education, and research institutions. Its products support AI applications like personal assistants, voice input, content generation, smart home devices, virtual humans, smart finance, and autonomous driving.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant overseas business expansion. Its overseas revenue grew substantially, accounting for nearly 48% of total revenue in 2024. It has established subsidiaries and data delivery bases in Singapore, the US, Hong Kong, and other countries, and its data collection covers multiple countries in Europe including Germany, Spain, Czech Republic, Russia, and Austria.
categories.supply_chain_position: Haitian Ruisheng operates mainly in the midstream of the AI supply chain, focusing on the development and production of high-quality training data sets essential for AI model training. It integrates upstream raw data collection and annotation services with downstream customized data products and application services, forming a comprehensive data supply chain ecosystem. The company also manages a diversified and globalized supply chain network, including overseas resource pools and strategic supplier partnerships.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D investment in AI foundational algorithms, integrated data processing platforms, and large model data services. It focuses on multi-language, multi-modal data, CoT reasoning datasets, and intelligent driving data annotation technologies. Strategic initiatives include global market expansion, enhancement of overseas delivery capabilities, exploration of emerging fields like embodied intelligence, and continuous improvement of data security and compliance frameworks. The firm also emphasizes talent development and advanced algorithmic research in speech, vision, and natural language.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through three models: customized training data services where fees are charged for bespoke datasets without transferring IP rights; standardized data product sales through licensing of proprietary datasets allowing multiple sales; and training data-related application services including software platform access, algorithm training, evaluation, and application services, often delivered via software licensing or integrated hardware-software solutions.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Haitian Ruisheng is a leading domestic AI foundational data service provider and the only listed company in its sector on the Shanghai Stock Exchange Sci-Tech Innovation Board. It competes with companies like Appen, DataTang, and Biaobei Technology. The company distinguishes itself through its comprehensive product portfolio, strong R&D capabilities, extensive multi-language coverage, and robust data security certifications. It holds a competitive edge in standardized data products and global market presence.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 237 million, a 39.45% increase year-over-year, driven by rapid growth in large model technologies and expanding application scenarios. Net profit attributable to shareholders turned positive at RMB 11.34 million, recovering from losses in the previous year. The company maintains total assets of about RMB 808 million and equity of RMB 743 million. R&D investment accounted for 26.76% of revenue, reflecting a strong commitment to innovation. Overseas revenue nearly doubled, contributing significantly to growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Haitian Ruisheng emphasizes high-quality, large-scale, and structured training data as the foundational 'fuel' for AI development, offering unique standardized data products with proprietary IP that enable clients to reduce model development time and costs. Its multi-language phonetic dictionaries and extensive linguistic research provide a competitive barrier. The company integrates advanced algorithmic tools and intelligent data processing platforms to enhance efficiency and data quality. Strong data security and compliance capabilities further differentiate it, ensuring trust and reliability for global clients.
